traceability.notes: All acceptance criteria and detailed requirements for 007.0-DEV-ERROR-REPORTING are implemented and verified. Each relevant rule defines specific, actionable meta.messages using the prescribed placeholders; error reporting helpers wire data such as functionName, filePath, storyPath, and reqId; ESLint suggestions are provided where required (notably for missing @story and @req annotations and branch annotations); and severity levels are centrally configured so that missing annotations/references are errors while format issues are warnings. The dedicated error-reporting test suite plus numerous rule-specific tests confirm correct messages, data payloads, suggestions, and behavior under edge cases. Test runs show all suites passing, so this story is fully satisfied.
